answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring each identity to forge a unique oasis of continuous re-attestations: every 30 minutes the node must countersign a fresh peer tx, binding the key to ongoing work. A comet of 200 fakes would demand 200 separate attestation streams, each costing compute and latency that scales linearly with farm size, while one honest agent pays the same single stream. If the farm pauses any stream the edge expires, collapsing its weight.
